projects.title: Pep Squad
projects.description: A silly motivation app. Pick a character from your squad, like a drill sergeant, a golden retriever, or a disappointed Victorian ghost, and get an AI pep talk read out loud in their voice.

projects.title: Whenabouts
projects.description: A daily guess-the-year game. Flip clue cards like the price of milk, the year-end #1 song, or the Super Bowl champion, each costing points, then lock in your guess for the mystery year. A new puzzle every day.

projects.title: bucketly
projects.description: Gamified bucket list app for travel and life goals. Browse curated lists like U.S. national parks, earn points based on difficulty, level up from Beginner to Grandmaster, and share your progress.

projects.title: Fan Fluent
projects.description: Learn sports teams by name, city and colors across five leagues: MLB, NBA, NFL, NHL and WNBA. Six quiz modes, extra practice on the teams you miss, and a different stadium-inspired look for each league. No accounts; it all runs in the browser.

about.heading: student, builder, adventurer.
paragraphs: Hi, I'm Roslyn. I'm based in the Bay Area, but originally from the East Coast.

I hold Bachelor's degrees in Computer Science and Business Management from Case Western Reserve University, and I'm currently pursuing my MBA at UC Berkeley Haas. Before business school, I spent 5 years as a Consultant at Deloitte, working with Big Tech clients on privacy and infrastructure/data center projects.
I enjoy staying active and spending time outdoors. Tennis is my favorite sport, and I'm on a mission to visit every national park.
